## 中文原文
早上你起床比平时晚，来不及在家吃早饭。路上买了个面包，一边走路一边吃。赶到公司的时候刚好踩点打卡，坐下来之后心跳还有点快。

## My translation
I got up late this morning, so I did not have enough time to eat breakfast at home.
I bought a bread and ate while walking.
By the time I arrived at the company, I just catch up the schedule.
After sitting down, my heart still beat a bit fast.

## Revised version
I got up late this morning, so I didn't have time for breakfast at home.
I bought a bun and ate it as I walked.
When I got to the office, I just made it in time to clock in.
After I sat down, my heart was still beating a little fast.

## Key phrases
- have time for breakfast, 比to eat breakfast简洁地道
- a bun，常用短语，一块面包
- as I walked，表示边走边吃的状态
- got to the office, 比arrived更口语化
- made it in time，及时赶上
- clock in，固定搭配，表示打卡
- was still beating，表示状态，心一直在跳
